params.body:
The signals under a trend were a grid of stone cards: six in view, the rest behind a "Show all N signals" fold. Since every signal is sent for readers who have the sources (#230, pipeline #378), a trend on fifty signals became a wall of cards, each labelled "Signal" and "View source".

Now they are rows in the style of the trend list (`components/trend-row`): a hairline above each, the source as the eyebrow caption, the signal in body type, and a muted ↗ that turns green on hover. The whole row is the link. Nothing folds away.

A reader without the sources still gets six rows, without caption or link (one column less), and the "+ N more signals feed this trend" counter becomes the last row with its upgrade link.

- `partials/signal-card` replaced by `partials/signal-row`
- `TrendSignalsTest` checks the wording instead of the fold

Tests: 475 of 476 pass; `BuildStampTest` fails in a worktree as it always does.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
params.title: Signals under a trend as open rows, like the trend list
